teaser: We never start by asking a customer to move. We integrate with what they run, build around it, and either retire our code or become the better place.
core_idea: Go to where the customer is: integrate with their existing systems, build around them, ride their upgrades, and keep only commodity parts underneath.

nodes.label: An MVP meets Odoo
nodes.summary: The organisation liked it and said they use Odoo.

nodes.label: Build around it
nodes.summary: Agents, policies, records and better interfaces on top.

nodes.label: The open source model
nodes.summary: Leverage what exists and use its upgrades.

nodes.label: Ours becomes the better place
nodes.summary: Data and work move over time.

nodes.label: Only commodity parts
nodes.summary: No database or servers of our own.

quotes.text: That is not an objection. It is the point.
There is a path where you replace the underlying technology, but you never start there.
When the system underneath improves, we delete code.

figures.caption: Integrate, build around it, and let time decide: their system gets better, or ours becomes the better place.
